writing.exampleCaption: This example is real: `cargo test` compiles and runs it.
writing.explanation: /// documents the item that follows and //! documents the enclosing module or crate. Code blocks inside doc comments are compiled and executed by `cargo test`, so an example that drifts out of date fails the build instead of quietly misleading the next reader.
writing.feedback: Doc examples are compiled and asserted, so a wrong example is a failing test.
